内容提要
唐僧带了徒弟孙悟空到一座观音院借宿。观音院的院
主企图得到唐僧的一领袈裟，定计烧害唐僧师徒。幸悟空
警觉，设法救了唐僧。结果，那院主反倒害了自己。那领
袈裟不料被黑风山的妖怪盗去。悟空为了找回这领袈裟，
不避艰险，几次三番地和那妖精进行坚决的斗争，终于把
袈裟夺回。
这段故事生动曲折，突出地表现了孙悟空不怕困难的
坚强性格，并叙述了善恶之间的斗争，善者必胜，恶者玩
火必遭自焚的下场。
1 悟空跟师父唐僧去西天取经。这天，过了鹰愁涧，
一路行来，不觉红日西沉，唐僧勒马观望，遥见山凹里有
座寺院，十分清幽。
page_text_en:
Content Summary
Tang Sanzang brought his disciple Sun Wukong to stay at a Guanyin Temple. The temple's abbot tried to obtain Tang Sanzang's robe and plotted to burn the master and his disciples. Fortunately, Wukong was alert and managed to save Tang Sanzang. As a result, the abbot ended up harming himself. Unexpectedly, the robe was then stolen by a demon from Black Wind Mountain. Wukong, determined to retrieve the robe, faced numerous dangers and fought fiercely against the demon several times, eventually reclaiming the robe.
This story is vivid and full of twists, highlighting Sun Wukong's fearless and resilient character, and narrates the struggle between good and evil, where good triumphs and evil inevitably brings self-destruction.
1. Wukong and his master Tang Sanzang were traveling to the West to fetch scriptures. That day, after passing Eagle-Sorrow Gorge, they traveled on and, as the sun set, Tang Sanzang reined in his horse and looked around, spotting a temple nestled in a valley, which looked very serene.
summary_zh: 本页包含《西游记》之七《黑风山》的内容提要，概述了唐僧师徒借宿观音院、袈裟被盗及孙悟空夺回袈裟的故事情节，并以第一幅插图和文字描述了师徒二人行至山凹，发现一座清幽寺院的场景。

2 师徒二人，来到山门一看，好一座高大寺院，匾额上题着“观音院”三个大字。唐僧下了马，悟空歇了担，正想跨门进去，忽见院内走出个僧人来。
3 唐僧忙让过一边，侍立门旁，与那和尚见过了礼。那和尚听说唐僧是东土钦差，去往西天取经，非常谦恭，连忙请他进去歇息。
弟子乃是东土钦差，要上西天拜佛求经，到此天色将晚，烦借上刹一宿。
原来是东土钦差，失迎了！请进，请进！
page_text_en:
2 The master and his disciple arrived at the mountain gate and saw a grand temple, with the name "Guanyin Temple" inscribed on the plaque. Tang Sanzang dismounted, and Wukong put down his burden. Just as they were about to enter, a monk came out from inside the temple.
3 Tang Sanzang stepped aside and stood by the door, exchanging greetings with the monk. Upon hearing that Tang Sanzang was an imperial envoy from the Eastern Land, sent to the Western Heaven to obtain scriptures, the monk became very respectful and hurriedly invited him in to rest.
Disciple, I am an imperial envoy from the Eastern Land, sent to the Western Heaven to worship Buddha and seek scriptures. It is getting late, and I kindly ask to stay for the night.
Ah, you are the imperial envoy from the Eastern Land! I apologize for the delay! Please come in, please come in!
summary_zh: 唐僧师徒来到观音院，唐僧向和尚说明来意，请求借宿一晚，和尚恭敬地迎接他们入内。

4 正说话间，悟空牵马进来。那和尚一见悟空相貌，当是天上的“雷公爷爷”下凡，不由打了个寒噤，早吓得跌爬地下，不住地向悟空磕头礼拜。
5 唐僧忙走过去说悟空是自己的徒弟，请他不要惊慌。那和尚这才放心，战兢兢地爬了起来，引他们进入室内。
这是我的徒弟，名叫悟空，丑自丑，心地甚好，休要害怕。
阿弥陀佛，险些儿要替我招魂哩。
page_text_en:
4 While they were talking, Wukong led the horse in. The monk, upon seeing Wukong's appearance, thought he was the heavenly 'Thunder God' descended to earth. He shivered, fell to the ground in fright, and kept bowing to Wukong.
5 The monk, upon seeing Wukong's appearance, thought he was the heavenly 'Thunder God' descended to earth. He shivered, fell to the ground in fright, and kept bowing to Wukong.
This is my disciple, named Wukong. He may be ugly, but his heart is good. Don't be afraid.
Ah, Buddha! I almost had to summon my own soul!
summary_zh: 孙悟空牵马进入观音院，其相貌吓坏了和尚，唐僧连忙解释并安抚，和尚才放心，将师徒二人引入室内。

6 唐僧师徒，刚刚坐定，见有两名小童，搀着一个腰驼背躬的老僧，缓步走来。
7 唐僧忙起身相迎，那老僧一边还礼，一边叫人献茶。顷刻间，两名小童，一个提着一把白铜水壶；一个捧着一个羊脂玉盘，上放三只珐蓝镶金的茶盅进来。
page_text_en:
6 The Tang Monk and his disciples had just sat down when they saw two young attendants supporting an old monk with a hunched back, walking slowly toward them.
7 The Tang Monk hurriedly rose to greet him. The old monk returned the bow and called for tea to be served. In a moment, two young attendants arrived: one carrying a white copper teapot, and the other holding a jade-white tray with three cloisonné-gilded tea cups.
summary_zh: 唐僧师徒在观音院安坐后，两位小童搀扶着一位驼背老僧前来相见，老僧还礼并吩咐献茶，随后小童端上白铜水壶和珐蓝镶金茶盅。

老爷是上邦高僧，随身定带有东土宝贝，可否借给老衲一看，以广眼界。
惭愧！东土无甚宝贝；就有时，路程遥远，也不便带得。
8 唐僧喝了一口茶，连声夸赞说：‘好茶，好茶！真是美食美器！’老僧听了，先自谦逊一回，接着问唐僧可有从东土带来的宝贝，借他一看。
袈裟称得甚宝贝；故院别的没有，袈裟却有的是。
你笑怎的？
9 唐僧正在推说没有什么宝贝，不料悟空却耐不住道：‘师父，你那领袈裟，难道不是宝贝？何不拿给他看看？’唐僧忙向他示意，哪知这老僧却因听说是件袈裟，倒不由呵呵大笑起来。
page_text_en:
Old Master, you are a high monk from the Eastern Land. You must have some precious treasures with you. May I borrow them to see, to broaden my horizons?
Shame! There are no precious treasures from the Eastern Land; even if there were, the journey is too long and it would be inconvenient to carry them.
8 Tang Sanzang took a sip of tea and praised it: 'Good tea, good tea! Truly exquisite food and fine utensils!' The old monk, after modestly declining, then asked Tang Sanzang if he had any precious treasures from the Eastern Land that he could borrow to see.
The robe is a precious treasure; this monastery has nothing else, but we do have the robe.
Why are you laughing?
9 While Tang Sanzang was trying to explain that he had no treasures, Wukong couldn't hold back and said: 'Master, your robe, isn't that a treasure? Why not show it to him?' Tang Sanzang hurriedly signaled to him, but the old monk, upon hearing it was a robe, couldn't help but burst into laughter.
summary_zh: 在观音院内，老僧向唐僧索要东土宝贝，唐僧推辞后，孙悟空提议展示袈裟，老僧听后大笑。

你们将库房中的几柜袈裟
全扛出来给这两位从东土大唐来的老爷们看看。
是。
10 这老僧有意要在唐僧面前卖弄自己富有。当即唤来
几名头陀，吩咐他们将藏放在库房中的袈裟，全数扛抬出
来。
11 不一会，几个头陀，扛来十二只柜子，开了锁，将
袈裟一件件抖开挂起，少说也有几百件。唐僧一看，果然尽
是绮绣绫罗，闪闪有光，使人眼花缭乱。
page_text_en:
You bring out all the cabinets of robes from the storeroom and show them to these two gentlemen who have come from the Eastern Tang Dynasty.
Yes.
10 The old monk intends to show off his wealth in front of Master Tang. He immediately calls over several monks and instructs them to bring out all the robes stored in the storeroom.
11 Soon after, several monks carry in twelve cabinets, unlock them, and spread out the robes one by one, hanging them up—there are at least hundreds of them. Master Tang looks and sees that they are all made of embroidered silk and brocade, shining brightly and dazzling the eyes.
summary_zh: 老僧为炫耀财富，命头陀将库房中数百件袈裟搬出并挂起展示，唐僧见后目眩神迷。

12 悟空看了一遍，笑道：“好，好！收起！收起！却看我们的。”说时，竟自去把包袱解开，取出唐僧的袈裟，抖开时，顿觉红光满室，彩气盈庭，满院众僧都看呆了。
13 这老僧见了这件宝贝，顿时动了歹心。跌跌撞撞地走到唐僧面前，扑的一声跪倒，央求唐僧允许他拿回后房去仔细观赏，明晨送还。唐僧听了，暗吃一惊。
page_text_en:
12 Wukong looked over them and laughed, "Good, good! Put them away! Put them away! Now let's see ours." As he spoke, he went and opened his pack, took out Tang Sanzang's robe, and when he spread it out, the room was instantly filled with red light and colorful radiance, leaving all the monks in the courtyard stunned.
13 The old monk, seeing this treasure, immediately had evil intentions. He stumbled over to Tang Sanzang, fell to his knees with a thud, and begged Tang Sanzang to allow him to take it back to the rear room for a careful viewing, promising to return it by morning. Tang Sanzang, upon hearing this, was secretly shocked.
summary_zh: 孙悟空展示唐僧的袈裟，光芒四射，令众僧惊呆；老僧见后心生歹念，跪求借袈裟回房观赏，唐僧闻言惊惧。

老院主要借去细看，便拿去是了。只是明晨务须还我，休给损污了。
这个自然，老爷您可放心！
14 唐僧一时疑难莫决，不由暗地埋怨悟空多事。悟空道：“给他拿去看吧，怕什么？如有差错，包在老孙身上！”这时唐僧推诿不得，只好将袈裟双手递给了老僧。
师祖要这袈裟不难，依我之见，不如抢了三间禅堂，一把火烧了，怕不把这两个行脚僧烧死才怪哩！
15 老僧把袈裟骗到手里，回到房里，便和几个心腹密议，打算将这袈裟谋吞过来。当时有个叫广谋的僧人，献了一个毒计，大家听了，都说：“妙计！妙计！”
page_text_en:
The old abbot wants to borrow it to examine closely, so take it. Just make sure to return it to me tomorrow morning, and don't damage it.
Of course, Master, you may rest assured!
14 Tang Sanzang hesitated, unable to decide, and secretly blamed Wukong for causing trouble. Wukong said, "Let him take it to look at. What's there to fear? If anything goes wrong, I'll take the blame!" At this point, Tang Sanzang could not refuse, so he handed the robe to the old monk with both hands.
Master, getting this robe is not difficult. In my opinion, why not seize the three meditation halls and burn them down? We could surely burn these two wandering monks to death!
15 The old monk tricked the robe into his hands, returned to his room, and secretly discussed with his close followers, planning to steal the robe. At that time, a monk named Guangmou proposed a sinister plan, and upon hearing it, everyone exclaimed, "Brilliant plan! Brilliant plan!"
summary_zh: 唐僧在孙悟空的劝说下，将袈裟交给老僧细看。老僧得手后，与心腹密谋，计划用火焚烧禅堂，杀害唐僧师徒，以夺取袈裟。

16 夜深以后，大小二百多和尚，一齐忙着去搬柴草。扛的扛，担的担，把个禅堂，前前后后，堆叠得四面不通。
17 悟空在禅堂里养神炼气，忽听门外声音嘈杂，心中疑惑，想开门出去看看，又恐惊醒师父。好悟空，摇身一变，变了个蜜蜂，从椽缝中飞了出来。
page_text_en:
16 After midnight, over two hundred monks, big and small, hurried to carry firewood and straw. Some carried it on their shoulders, others on poles, piling up the meditation hall front and back until it was blocked on all sides.
17 Wukong was cultivating his spirit and refining his energy in the meditation hall when he suddenly heard noisy sounds outside. He felt puzzled and wanted to go out to see, but feared waking his master. Good Wukong, he transformed with a shake of his body, turned into a bee, and flew out through a crack in the beam.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了观音院的和尚们在夜深后秘密搬运柴草，准备放火；孙悟空在禅堂内察觉异样，便化作蜜蜂从房梁缝隙飞出查看。

18 悟空出来一看，不觉暗自好笑。心想：‘这厮们胆敢要害我们。我要拿棍打吧，可怜又不经打。好吧，你爱玩火，管教你尝尝火的滋味！’主意打定，一个跟斗，跳上了南天门。
19 守天门的兵将，见闹天宫的大圣又来了，吓得一个个东躲西闪。悟空忙摇手喊道：‘列位不要惊慌，我是有事来找广目天王来的。’众兵将哪里肯信，都站得远远的不敢近前。
page_text_en:
18 Wukong came out and couldn't help laughing to himself. He thought: 'These rascals dare to harm us. I could beat them with my staff, but they're too pitiful and wouldn't stand a chance. Well, if you love playing with fire, I'll make you taste the flavor of fire!' Having made up his mind, he did a somersault and leapt up to the Southern Heavenly Gate.
19 The soldiers guarding the Heavenly Gate, seeing the Great Sage who had caused chaos in Heaven return, were frightened and scattered in all directions. Wukong hurriedly waved his hands and shouted: 'Don't panic, everyone! I have something important to discuss with the Heavenly King of the Southern Heaven.' The soldiers didn't believe him for a moment and stood far away, daring not to approach.
summary_zh: 孙悟空发现观音院和尚欲放火害人，便化作蜜蜂飞出查看，随后跳上南天门，向守门兵将说明来意，但兵将因他曾大闹天宫而不敢靠近。

老孙保唐僧西天取经，路遇歹人，放火烧他，赶快将你的避火罩儿拿来使使，即刻送还。
这猴子还是这般性急，避火罩我自借你，但用完了即来还我，不要丢了。
20 这时，天王正好从里面走出来。悟空忙迎上去道：
“我正要找你，快快将你的避火罩儿借给老孙一用。”天王见是当年的齐天大圣，不敢不借，只得将避火罩借给了他。
21 悟空拿了避火罩，驾起云头，直到禅堂，将唐僧和白马、行李一起罩住了。然后转身到那老僧住的方丈屋脊上坐定，保护那件袈裟。
page_text_en:
Old Sun is protecting Tang Sanzang on his journey to the West to fetch scriptures. He encountered villains who set fire to him. Quickly, bring your fire-proof cover and use it, and return it immediately.
This monkey is still so impatient. I'll lend you the fire-proof cover, but return it to me as soon as you're done, and don't lose it.
20 At this moment, the Heavenly King came out from inside. Wukong hurriedly greeted him, saying: 
"I was just looking for you. Quickly lend me your fire-proof cover!" The Heavenly King, seeing the former Great Sage Equaling Heaven, dared not refuse, and had to lend the fire-proof cover to him.
21 Wukong took the fire-proof cover, rode on the clouds, and arrived at the meditation hall, covering Tang Sanzang, the White Horse, and their luggage. Then he turned around and sat on the roof of the old monk's residence, protecting the robe.
summary_zh: 孙悟空向天王借得避火罩后，用它罩住唐僧、白马和行李，并坐于老僧方丈屋脊上，保护袈裟以防火灾。

22 一会儿，见和尚在禅堂外放起火来。悟空恨那老僧心毒，便尽力吸一口气吹将出去，顿时刮起一阵狂风。火借风势，风助火威，霎时间把一座观音院烧得火光一片，满天通红。
23 这时慌得满院和尚，一个个光头赤脚，忙着往外搬箱抬柜，慌乱中东倒西歪，你推我撞，叫苦连天。
page_text_en:
22 After a while, the monks set fire outside the meditation hall. Wukong, hating the old monk's treachery, took a deep breath and blew it out, instantly creating a fierce wind. The fire fed on the wind, and the wind fanned the flames, quickly turning the entire Guanyin Temple into a sea of fire, blazing red across the sky.
23 At this moment, the monks in the courtyard panicked, each bareheaded and barefoot, frantically carrying boxes and cabinets out. In the chaos, they stumbled and bumped into each other, crying out in distress.
summary_zh: 孙悟空发现观音院和尚放火后，吹气助风，使火势迅速蔓延，整个寺院陷入火海；和尚们惊慌失措，纷纷逃出寺院搬运财物，场面混乱。

24 不料这场大火，却惊动了一个妖怪。原来观音院南面有座黑风山，山上有有个黑风洞，洞里有个黑风怪。这时他正睡醒翻身，见从窗缝里透进亮光，好生奇怪，忙推窗观望。
25 那妖一眼望去，但见北山下一片红光，料定是观音院失火了。心想：‘这些和尚好不小心，待我去救他一救。’想罢，他就纵起云头，直向观音院奔来。
page_text_en:
24 Unexpectedly, this great fire startled a demon. Originally, to the south of Guanyin Temple, there was a Black Wind Mountain, on which lay a Black Wind Cave, home to the Black Wind Demon. At that moment, he was just waking up and turning over, when he saw bright light seeping through the window crack. Curious, he hurriedly pushed open the window to look.

55 悟空缠住他不放，那怪便虚幌一枪，返身回洞。悟空紧紧追去，说时迟，那时快，砰的一声，石门紧闭，把悟空关在洞外。
page_text_en:
54 The two fought at the cave entrance for half a day. As noon approached, the demon stopped his spear and said, 'Hold on, let me have lunch first, then we'll fight again.' Wukong replied, 'If you're a real man, how can you be hungry after half a day? Come on! Let's fight again!' 
55 Wukong wouldn't let him go. The demon feigned a thrust and turned back into the cave. Wukong chased after him. Too late, too fast—bang! The stone door slammed shut, trapping Wukong outside.
summary_zh: 孙悟空与黑怪在洞口激战半天，黑怪以吃饭为由暂停战斗，孙悟空不允，继续追击，黑怪趁机逃回洞中并关上石门，将孙悟空困在洞外。

我和那黑怪，在洞口战了半日，那怪逃入洞去，关门不出，老孙一时攻打不开，便也乘此回来看看师父。

我在此甚好，自可放心。袈裟既有下落，你且吃了斋饭，务必再去争取回来！

悟空说：‘莫忙。袈裟果是给那个黑怪偷了……’话未说完，那些和尚已忙着献上素供，请悟空用斋。

59 悟空在云端里看得真切，料想这匣里定是什么柬札，便降下来，打了小妖一棒，小妖立刻身亡。
page_text_en:
58 Wukong hastily ate some vegetarian food and then rushed toward Heifeng Mountain. As he was walking, he suddenly saw a small demon hurrying along, carrying a rosewood box.
59 Wukong saw clearly from the clouds and guessed that the box must contain some important letter. He descended, struck the small demon with his staff, and the demon died instantly.
summary_zh: 孙悟空在返回黑风山途中，发现一个小妖携带花梨木匣，怀疑其中有重要物品，便从云端降下，一棒打死小妖。

60. 悟空拿过匣来掀开一看，原来是那黑怪邀观音院老僧讲道的一个请帖。悟空见帖上具名“熊罴”，料知这怪是个熊精。心想：“这老剥皮和妖精勾结，死得一点不屈。”
61. 悟空忽生一计：“这老剥皮的模样，我还记得，何不变成他的样子到黑风洞去，倘能骗得袈裟到手，却也省力。”随即摇身一变，变成与老和尚一般无二。
page_text_en:
60. Wukong took the box and opened it. Inside was an invitation from the black demon to the old monk of Guanyin Temple for a lecture. Seeing the name 'Xiong Pi' on the invitation, Wukong realized the demon was a bear spirit. He thought to himself: 'This old skinflint colluding with demons deserves to die without complaint.'
61. Wukong suddenly had an idea: 'I remember the appearance of this old skinflint. Why not transform into his likeness and go to Heifeng Cave? If I can trick the robe into my hands, it would save me effort.' He immediately transformed, becoming indistinguishable from the old monk.
summary_zh: 孙悟空发现小妖携带的匣中是黑怪邀请观音院老僧讲道的请帖，得知黑怪名为‘熊罴’，认定其为熊精。他随即想出计策，决定变成老和尚的模样前往黑风洞骗取袈裟。

page_text_en:

63 Wukong walked in confidently. As he reached the courtyard, he saw pine and bamboo interwoven in green, peach and plum trees in full bloom, making the place look surprisingly serene. At that moment, the black demon appeared, smiling and welcoming him.
summary_zh: 孙悟空化身为老和尚，来到黑风洞口，小妖误认其为观音院老僧，开门放行；孙悟空大模大样走进洞内，行至天井，见景色幽静，黑怪笑着迎出。

65 黑怪闻报，暴跳如雷，提枪来刺悟空。悟空现了本相，急从耳里取出铁棒，二人争斗起来。吓得一群小妖各自抱头乱窜。
page_text_en:
64 The monster walked forward, took Wukong by the hand, and led him into the central hall. After bowing, they sat down. Before they could say a few words, suddenly a small mountain patrol demon hurried in, reporting from outside.
65 Upon hearing the report, the black monster jumped up in rage, brandishing his spear to stab Wukong. Wukong revealed his true form, quickly pulled out his iron staff from his ear, and the two began to fight. The other small demons were frightened and scrambled away, covering their heads.
summary_zh: 孙悟空化身为老和尚进入黑风洞，被黑怪以礼相待，但巡山小妖报信后，黑怪大怒，孙悟空现出原形，双方展开激战，小妖们惊慌逃窜。

66 他两个从中厅斗到洞口，从洞口又打上山头，由山头又杀到空中。直打得山摇地动，地黑天昏。

page_text_en:

67 As the red sun was about to set, the monster suddenly jumped out of the circle and shouted: 'Monkey, stop! It's getting late today; let's settle this tomorrow!' Wukong replied: 'If you want to fight, then let's fight all night long—I won't let you escape with excuses!' He leaped forward and struck again with his staff.
summary_zh: 孙悟空与黑怪在黑风洞内外激烈交战，从洞中打到空中，战斗激烈至日落时分，黑怪欲停战，孙悟空不允，继续追击。

page_text_en:

summary_zh: 黑怪化作清风逃回洞中，孙悟空扑空后返回观音院向唐僧汇报战况，唐僧因袈裟未取回而忧愁，孙悟空内心感到愧疚。

71 等天一亮，悟空跳起身来，说道：‘师父放心，老孙今天不把袈裟取还，誓不回院！’唐僧忙下床将他一把扯住，问道：‘你往哪里去？’悟空道：‘我去找南海观音！’
page_text_en:
70 That night, the master and disciple still rested in the meditation hall. Tang Sanzang, missing his robe, tossed and turned all night, unable to sleep. Wukong, too, was anxious, having failed to defeat the black demon twice.
71 As soon as dawn broke, Wukong jumped up and said, 'Master, don't worry. I swear I won't return to the temple until I retrieve the robe!' Tang Sanzang hurriedly got out of bed and grabbed him, asking, 'Where are you going?' Wukong replied, 'I'm going to find the South Sea Guanyin!'
summary_zh: 当夜师徒二人因袈裟未取回而辗转难眠，次日清晨孙悟空立誓取回袈裟，唐僧追问去向，孙悟空表示要去找南海观音求助。

因事特来拜谒菩萨，烦为通报。
72 悟空说完，纵身跳上云端，转眼间，到了南海落伽山，按落云头，行到紫竹林中，早有护法韦陀迎将出来。
73 不一会，菩萨让小童传话出来，叫悟空进去。悟空走至宝莲台前对菩萨躬身一拜说：‘我师父路过你的禅院，被你的邻居黑熊妖偷去了袈裟，屡讨不还，特来找你讨要。’
page_text_en:
I heard the Bodhisattva said you have reformed and turned to goodness, protecting Master Tang on his journey to the West to obtain scriptures. Why are you here today?
I have come specially to pay my respects to the Bodhisattva. Please inform her.

73 Soon after, the Bodhisattva sent a young attendant to tell Wukong to come in. Wukong walked to the Lotus Throne and bowed respectfully to the Bodhisattva, saying: 'My master passed by your monastery and had his robe stolen by your neighbor, the Black Bear Demon. He has refused to return it despite repeated requests. I have come specially to ask you for it.'
summary_zh: 孙悟空前往南海落伽山求助观音菩萨，向菩萨说明唐僧的袈裟被黑熊妖偷走，请求菩萨帮忙讨回。

84 After the two had settled and exchanged pleasantries, the Bodhisattva rose, holding a tray in one hand, walked to the demon's front, picked out the larger pill, and handed it to the demon, saying: 'A humble offering of an elixir, may Your Majesty live a thousand years!'
85 The demon quickly rose, took a smaller pill and offered it to the Bodhisattva, saying: 'May I share longevity with Master Lingxu!' After the exchange, the demon put the larger pill into his own mouth. Unbeknownst to him, as soon as the pill entered his mouth, without him swallowing, it 'plopped' down into his stomach.
summary_zh: 观音菩萨化身凌虚子，向黑熊精献上仙丹，黑熊精误以为是真丹，将孙悟空变的大丹吞下，计策成功实施。

86 那妖正觉奇怪，不料悟空已在肚里动起手来。他头一顶，脚一蹬，痛得那黑怪肝肠欲断，满地乱滚。这时菩萨已现了原身，喝问：‘佛衣何在？’
87 黑怪知已受骗，莫奈何，只得命小妖去把袈裟取来。菩萨接过佛衣，恐他再生无理，便拿出一个箍儿，套在黑怪头上。
page_text_en:
86 The demon was just feeling strange, not realizing that Wukong had already started causing trouble inside his belly. He raised his head and kicked his legs, in agony, the black demon writhing on the ground with his insides torn apart. At this moment, the Bodhisattva revealed her true form and shouted, 'Where is the Buddhist robe?'
87 The black demon, realizing he had been deceived, had no choice but to order his minions to fetch the robe. The Bodhisattva took the robe and, fearing he might act unreasonably again, took out a ring and placed it on the demon's head.
summary_zh: 孙悟空在黑熊精腹中作乱，使其痛苦不堪，观音菩萨现身逼问袈裟下落；黑熊精无奈命小妖取回袈裟，观音菩萨接过袈裟后，为防其反悔，将其头套上金箍。

title_en: Comic Book 'Journey to the West 07: Black Wind Mountain'
source_file: 连环画《西游记07：黑风山》（6-10岁）.pdf

88 然后叫声：‘悟空，袈裟已在，你出来吧，休伤他性命。’悟空‘唰’的从他鼻孔里窜了出来。
89 那怪恢复原状，勃然大怒，霍地跳起身，奔去拿条黑缨枪，喝声：‘看枪！’对准菩萨胸前刺来。
page_text_en:
88 Then she called out: 'Wukong, the robe is here, come out, do not harm his life.' Wukong 'whooshed' out from his nostril.
89 The monster resumed his original form, furiously angry, leapt up, rushed to grab a black-tasseled spear, and shouted: 'Look out!' as he thrust it toward the Bodhisattva's chest.
summary_zh: 观音菩萨取回袈裟后，命令孙悟空从黑熊精鼻孔中出来，黑熊精恢复原形后大怒，持枪向菩萨刺去。

90 菩萨见他刺来，便和悟空腾在空中，念动真言，那怪霎时头痛难禁，狂呼：“饶命！”悟空见状，拍手大笑道：“菩萨休停，快念上他娘千遍万遍，叫他早些了帐！
91 菩萨这才按落云头，给他摩顶受戒，命他执了长枪，跟随左右。回头将袈裟递给悟空道：“你回去吧，好生服侍唐僧，休再生事。”说着，带了熊罴，回南海去了。
page_text_en:
90 The Bodhisattva saw him charging and, together with Wukong, rose into the air, chanting the true words. The monster instantly suffered unbearable headache and screamed, "Spare my life!" Wukong, seeing this, clapped his hands and laughed, "Bodhisattva, don't stop! Chant 'her mother' a thousand times, ten thousand times, and make him settle his account sooner!"
91 The Bodhisattva then descended from the clouds, gave him a blessing on the head, ordered him to take the long spear, and follow by his side. Turning back, he handed the robe to Wukong, saying, "Go back now, take good care of Tang Sanzang, and don't cause trouble again." Saying this, he took the black bear and returned to the South Sea.
summary_zh: 黑熊精持枪刺向观音菩萨，菩萨与孙悟空腾空念咒使其头痛难忍，孙悟空催促菩萨念咒。随后菩萨为黑熊精摩顶受戒，命其执枪跟随，并将袈裟交还孙悟空，带黑熊精返回南海。

92 悟空见菩萨去远，便也按落云头，将袈裟挂在树上，取出铁棒，重又打入洞去。哪知那些小妖，早已惊散一空，悟空找不到一个小妖，便一把火将妖洞烧了。
93 悟空烧了黑风洞，赶回观音院，这里唐僧正等得焦急，忽见悟空手捧袈裟从空降落，心中大喜。众僧听得袈裟已经取回，都拍手称快。
page_text_en:
92 Wukong saw the Bodhisattva had gone far away, so he also descended from the clouds, hung the robe on a tree, took out his iron staff, and re-entered the cave. He found that the little demons had already scattered, and since he couldn't find a single one, he set the demon cave on fire.
93 Wukong burned down the Black Wind Cave and hurried back to the Guanyin Temple. Tang Sanzang was waiting anxiously there when suddenly he saw Wukong descending from the sky holding the robe, and he was overjoyed. The other monks, hearing that the robe had been retrieved, all clapped their hands in delight.
summary_zh: 孙悟空在观音菩萨离开后，将袈裟挂在树上，烧毁了黑风洞，随后返回观音院，唐僧和众僧见他带回袈裟，十分欢喜。
